output.advice: Keep the blue outline and star positions; the main fixes are label layout and making the bag read as a goatskin. (1) Move labels off the strap and body so none overlap: place 28237's label to the left of the tassel at about (150, 330), and move 26640's label below the ring at about (300, 340), not beside 29696's line. (2) Shorten or wrap long labels so they are not clipped at the right edge (25428 at about (441, 225) and 26451 at about (361, 470)); put the 25428 label above-right and wrap the text. (3) Make the tassel visibly hang from the knot 27830 at about (246, 257): move 28237 to about (232, 290) with a short line from the knot. (4) Strengthen the bag read: draw the neck (25984 at about (393, 107)) narrower and tied, and widen the lower body toward 26451 so the body reads as a swollen goatskin with a drink-settling base. Verdict: redraw, because match is 3 and the guess does not name a bag.
